description: Evaluation stratum: NB (New Brunswick MagPlot), QC (ESI-covered Quebec), or POOLED (both combined).

NSVB stand attribute: BA (basal area), SDI (stand density index), QMD (quadratic mean diameter), TOPHT (top height), TOTVOL (total volume), MERCHVOL (merchantable volume), SAWVOL (sawlog volume), BIOMASS (aboveground biomass), VALUE (stand value).
Number of stands in the evaluation cell.
Observed mean of the metric over the cell (FIA NSVB reference).
Model-predicted mean of the metric over the cell.
Mean level bias as a percent: 100 * (pred_mean - obs_mean) / obs_mean. Positive is over-prediction, negative is under-prediction.
Root mean squared error of predicted versus observed at the stand level.
Nash-Sutcliffe modeling efficiency; 1 is perfect, 0 matches the observed mean, negative is worse than the mean.
Observed periodic annual increment (mean rate of change of the metric).
Qualitative status of the cell: green (acceptable), yellow (caution), red (poor).
